title: Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Growth, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just for you.


**Responsibilities**

To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new\-to\-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM* INR 1 million through a “need\-based approach,\” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
* To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross\-sell and up\-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage \& maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement \& relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
* Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
* Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self\-sourcing, referrals, branch walk\-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly \& annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e\-Channels (I\-Banking / M\-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
* Ensure proper implementation \& execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new\- to\- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on\-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
* Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM \=\> INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products \& services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health \& Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on\-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products
* Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
* Mandatory \- Graduate (10\+2\+3 years of education)
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Strong service orientation, customer\-centric behavior
* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Self\-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results\-orientated \& the ability to deliver results under pressure
* In\-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities
* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para\-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements \& Anti\-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
* Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
* Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
* Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients

**Apply Now**

* We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and the professional advantages of a dynamic environment that supports your development and recognises your achievements

Eachanari, Coimbatore

Regular

title: Client Operations & Account Manager (North America)
description:
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (Hybrid: Office \+ Work from Home) – Heini Sports Store

**Work Schedule:** Monday – Saturday \| 3:30 PM – 12:00 AM IST (Aligns with North American EST hours)

**Compensation:** ₹4,50,000 – ₹6,00,000 Fixed Base LPA \+ ₹1,20,000 – ₹2,00,000 Performance \& Sales Incentives (Total Target OTE: ₹5,70,000 – ₹8,00,000\+ LPA)

**Employment Type:** Full\-time/Hybrid

**Website:** https://heinisports.in/

**About the Role**

We are seeking a high\-energy, detail\-oriented **Client Operations \& Account Manager** to lead our client operations and account management for North American sports teams, clubs, and athletic organizations.

In this role, you will be the single point of contact for North American team managers and coaches—guiding them through custom team apparel orders, managing design approvals, overseeing team store setups, and coordinating with our production and admin team in Coimbatore. During operational downtime, you will actively reach out to endurance sports clubs (cycling, running, triathlon, rowing) to build new client relationships.

**Detailed Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Client Communication \& Account Management (North America)**

* Manage incoming client inquiries and scheduled video/phone discovery calls via Calendly.
* Walk team managers and club presidents through product catalogs, custom sublimation options, fabrics, chamois pads, sizing charts, and tiered price structures.
* Coordinate the dispatch, tracking, and return of physical fit sample kits before team orders open.
* Issue clear, accurate price estimates, formal quotes, and digital invoices.

**2\. Design \& Production Workflow Execution**

* Serve as the primary bridge between North American clients and internal graphic designers.
* Verify that client artwork meets vector requirements (.AI, .EPS, PDF) and confirm Pantone (PMS) color codes before print handoff.
* Translate design feedback clearly to ensure digital mockups match client specifications.
* Manage custom team store lifecycles: set open/close ordering windows, monitor garment minimums (MOQs), and send reminders to club leads before store cut\-offs.
* Coordinate delivery schedules and manage client expectations around lead times during peak athletic seasons.

**3\. On\-Site Operations \& Team Mentorship**

* Work out of our Coimbatore office during the initial shift hours (e.g., 2:30 PM – 6:00 PM IST) before transitioning to remote coverage.
* Guide and train 2 junior office associates on order batching, team store backend tasks, dispatch packaging, and courier tracking.
* Inspect physical fabric proofs and finished garment samples on\-site before dispatch.

**4\. Business Development \& Pipeline Growth**

* Identify and reach out to endurance sports clubs, university athletic teams, and corporate charity events across the US and Canada during off\-peak windows.
* Re\-engage past accounts for seasonal kit refreshes, top\-up orders, and re\-orders.

**Compensation \& Incentive Structure**

* **Fixed Base Salary:** ₹35,000 – ₹50,000 / month (₹4\.2L – ₹6\.0L LPA based on experience and communication proficiency).
* **Shift Allowance:** Included within the competitive fixed package for EST overlap.
* **New Client Acquisition Incentive:** 2% to 4% of Net Invoiced Order Value paid on every newly acquired club or corporate order once payment is cleared.
* **Account Retention \& Operations Bonus:** Quarterly performance bonus (up to ₹20,000/quarter) tied to on\-time delivery execution and zero order fulfillment errors.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Fluency:** Exceptional, neutral spoken and written English with confidence on live video calls.
* **Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in B2B client servicing, inside sales, export merchandising, or customer operations.
* **Location \& Shift Readiness:** Must be based in or willing to commute to our Coimbatore facility for the hybrid schedule (3:30 PM – 12:00 AM IST).
* **Technical Proficiency:** Comfortable with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive), video conferencing (Zoom, Google Meet), and basic e\-commerce or CRM systems.

We evaluate candidates based on practical communication skills rather than resume summaries.

title: product development and Market Research
description:
Job description:

Product Development \& Market Research Executive

**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Department:** Product Development / R\&D / Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 1\+ Years  
**Reports To:** Product Development Manager / Head of Product Development

About the Company

We are a leading hygiene products manufacturer in India, offering **plant\-based, eco\-conscious solutions across personal care categories**. Our products are developed in certified facilities and recognized through multiple national and state awards.

With a growing team of **55\+ employees**, we foster a supportive, ethical, and performance\-driven work culture. We value innovation, quality, and collaboration, providing a positive work environment where individuals can learn, contribute, and grow with a purpose\-led brand.

About the Role

We are looking for a **Product Development \& Market Research Executive** with 1\+ years of experience to support new product development, market research, competitor analysis, customer insights, product improvement, and commercialization activities.

The role involves identifying market opportunities, studying consumer needs and industry trends, coordinating with R\&D and other teams, and supporting the development of products that align with customer expectations and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities 1\. Product Development

* Support the development of new products based on market demand, customer requirements, and business opportunities.
* Assist in identifying new product ideas, product concepts, features, formats, and applications.
* Coordinate with R\&D, Production, Quality, Purchase, Packaging, and Marketing teams during product development.
* Support product trials, sample development, testing, evaluation, and improvement activities.
* Maintain proper documentation of product concepts, trials, specifications, and development status.
* Track product development activities from initial concept through commercialization.
* Support improvements to existing products based on customer feedback and market requirements.

2\. Market Research

* Conduct primary and secondary market research to identify market opportunities and emerging trends.
* Research customer preferences, buying behavior, product expectations, and changing market needs.
* Study market size, product categories, pricing, positioning, and customer segments.
* Collect information through customer interactions, retailer feedback, online research, surveys, and competitor analysis.
* Prepare market research reports and present key findings to management.
* Identify potential gaps in the market that can be addressed through new or improved products.

3\. Competitor Analysis

* Monitor competitor products, launches, pricing, packaging, product features, claims, and positioning.
* Conduct regular competitor benchmarking across relevant personal care and hygiene categories.
* Compare product features, pricing, pack sizes, ingredients/materials, positioning, and customer reviews.
* Track competitor marketing and promotional activities.
* Prepare competitor analysis reports and communicate relevant findings to the product development and management teams.

4\. Customer \& Consumer Insights

* Gather customer and consumer feedback on existing and proposed products.
* Identify customer pain points, product expectations, preferences, and unmet needs.
* Analyze customer reviews, complaints, feedback, and market responses.
* Convert relevant customer insights into product improvement or new product opportunities.
* Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and other teams to collect market feedback.

5\. New Product Opportunity Identification

* Identify emerging categories, market trends, consumer needs, and potential product opportunities.
* Research new product formats, materials, ingredients, technologies, packaging concepts, and applications relevant to the business.
* Evaluate potential product opportunities based on market demand, competition, pricing, feasibility, and business potential.
* Prepare initial product opportunity reports for management review.
* Support feasibility studies and preliminary product evaluations.

6\. Product Testing \& Evaluation

* Coordinate product samples and trials with relevant internal teams.
* Maintain records of sample evaluations, trial results, customer feedback, and product modifications.
* Support product comparison and benchmarking activities.
* Coordinate with quality and R\&D teams for required testing and evaluation.
* Track product improvement actions and ensure timely follow\-up.

7\. Product Documentation

* Maintain product development trackers and project documentation.
* Prepare product comparison sheets, market research reports, competitor analysis, and product evaluation reports.
* Maintain product specifications, sample details, trial records, and development timelines.
* Ensure development\-related information is updated accurately and systematically.
* Support preparation of product presentations and internal review documents.

8\. Packaging \& Product Presentation

* Support development and evaluation of product packaging concepts.
* Research competitor packaging, pack sizes, design trends, usability, and customer preferences.
* Coordinate with Design, Marketing, and Production teams for packaging development.
* Support evaluation of packaging functionality, appearance, and suitability for the target market.
* Ensure product and packaging information is aligned with approved requirements.

9\. Product Launch Support

* Support planning and execution of new product launches.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, Production, Quality, and other teams for launch readiness.
* Support preparation of product information, product presentations, sales inputs, and launch materials.
* Track initial market response after product launch.
* Collect feedback and recommend improvements based on market performance.

10\. Data Analysis \& Reporting

* Analyze market, product, customer, and competitor data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations for management.
* Use Excel to organize, analyze, and present market and product data.
* Maintain trackers for product development projects, competitor analysis, market research, and product performance.
* Support data\-driven decision\-making for product development and market expansion.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **business administration, marketing, product management, food science, biotechnology, chemistry, engineering, or a related field**.
* **1\+ years of experience** in product development, market research, product management, R\&D coordination, marketing research, or a related role.
* Experience in FMCG, personal care, hygiene, consumer products, manufacturing, or related industries is preferred.
* Good understanding of market research and competitor analysis.
* Strong analytical and research skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work with multiple teams and manage development activities.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.

Preferred Skills

* Product development
* Market research
* Consumer research
* Competitor analysis
* Product benchmarking
* New product opportunity identification
* Product testing and evaluation
* Customer feedback analysis
* Product lifecycle understanding
* Packaging research
* Market trend analysis
* Project coordination
* Report preparation
* Presentation skills

Software \& Technical Skills

* **MS Excel / Google Sheets**
* MS PowerPoint
* Google Workspace
* Market research and data analysis tools
* CRM / ERP systems – added advantage
* Power BI – added advantage
* Advanced Excel functions, Pivot Tables, Charts, and data analysis – preferred

Personal Attributes

* Curious and research\-oriented mindset
* Strong analytical thinking
* Creative and innovative approach
* Good observation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Strong follow\-up and coordination skills
* Willingness to learn new products, technologies, and market trends
* Business and customer\-oriented mindset

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation
* Performance\-linked incentives
* Career growth opportunities
* Learning and development opportunities
* Supportive and collaborative work culture
* Opportunity to work on innovative and purpose\-driven products
* Opportunity to contribute directly to new product development and business growth

Apply Now

If you are a research\-oriented and creative professional with an interest in **product development, market research, consumer insights, and new product opportunities**, and you are looking to grow with a purpose\-driven organization, we would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
